items.html: All these four bottom Sefirot of the current Beria are the meaning of Ever ha Yarden, and they are Tifferet and Netzah and Hod and Yesod of the current Beria. However, Malchut of the current Beria that was then the fourth Sefira de Assiya is called Suria and her degree is worse than Ever ha Yarden.
